title: What Should Have Been Done
grammar: Past Conditional (ha + múlt idő + volna) and Unfulfilled Past Obligation (kellett volna)
goal: I can say what should have been done, using kellett volna.
I can say what would have been better, using jobb lett volna, ha ….
I can talk about an omission and about taking responsibility.
